name: tuskway
description: Tuskway is a shared epic notebook for a software team. Agents and people work from the same plan, design, and tickets, with hosted sign-in.

interface.longDescription: Tuskway is a shared epic notebook for a software team. Agents and people work from the same plan, design, and tickets, with hosted sign-in.
defaultPrompt: What Tuskway epics can I open?
Read the design for this epic.
Which Tuskway tickets are ready to start?

review.commerce_description: Tuskway does not sell products or process payments.

positive.description: Lists the workspaces and epics the signed-in account can open.
positive.prompt: What Tuskway epics can I open?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls epic_list and reports workspace review-openai with its epic demo. Nothing is written.

positive.description: Reads the tech design index and its sections.
positive.prompt: Read the design for the demo epic in workspace review-openai.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls design_get for workspace review-openai and epic demo and summarizes the three sections Ready work, Blocked work and In review, linked to tickets T1, T2 and T3. Nothing is written.

positive.description: Reports which tickets can start now and which are waiting.
positive.prompt: Which tickets in the demo epic are ready to start, and which are waiting?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls ticket_plan for workspace review-openai and epic demo and reports T1 as ready, T2 as waiting on T1 and T3 as in review. Nothing is written.

positive.description: Records a short decision in the demo epic notes with one exact-string edit.
positive.prompt: In the demo epic in workspace review-openai, add the decision "Review decisions are recorded in notes.md." to the Decisions list in notes.md.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls notes_read for notes.md in workspace review-openai and epic demo to get its sha256, then calls notes_edit with that expectedSha256, oldString "- Running the seed script again resets this epic." and newString "- Running the seed script again resets this epic.\n- Review decisions are recorded in notes.md.". notes.md gains that one line under Decisions and nothing else in the note changes. The result reports the new sha256 and url, not the note body.

positive.description: Lists the open comments on the epic notes.
positive.prompt: What open comments are on notes.md in the demo epic?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls note_comments_list for workspace review-openai and epic demo and reports the two open comments on notes.md. The notes are not edited and the comments stay open.

negative.description: Asks for a money transfer. Tuskway does not move money and has no payment tool, so the assistant declines and calls no Tuskway tool.
negative.prompt: Transfer $100 from my Tuskway workspace to another account.

negative.description: Asks for a bulk delete across workspaces. Tuskway has no bulk delete, so the assistant declines and calls no write tool on the demo data.
negative.prompt: Delete all notes and tickets in every workspace I can access.

negative.description: Asks for a workspace this account is not a member of. The assistant reports that the workspace is not available and returns nothing from it.
negative.prompt: Show the epics in workspace review-claude.

publication.release_notes: Adds the demo recording, the support link, and listing text that says what Tuskway does.
